
> Independent production AI readiness and cloud AI economics reviews. India-first, available internationally.

## Canonical services
- [Production AI Readiness](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/production-ai-readiness/): evaluation, authority, security, recovery, economics and release evidence.
- [Cloud and AI Economics](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/cloud-ai-economics/): cost ownership, allocation, unit economics and safe action planning.

## Evidence
- [AWS bill too high? Owner action checklist](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/customer-problem-search/aws-cloud-bill-too-high/): synthetic, no-credentials checklist and buyer-safe evidence-intake CSV for unexpected AWS spend before risky cuts or commitments.
- [Buyer-safe cloud bill evidence intake CSV](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/customer-problem-search/aws-cloud-bill-too-high/aws-cloud-bill-owner-evidence-intake.csv): synthetic fields for ownership, driver classification, action safety and commitment review; no savings, ROI or production claim.
- [WhatsApp lead follow-up vs CRM source card](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/global-whatsapp-lead-follow-up-vs-crm-automation-comparison/whatsapp-lead-follow-up-ai-answer-source-card.json): claim-safe source card for owners comparing WhatsApp follow-up, CRM, chatbot, agency, spreadsheet and AICS owner-evidence routes before credentials, customer data, revenue, ROI or ranking claims.
- [Portfolio](https://aicloudstrategist.com/portfolio/): proof labels and representative deliverables.
- [Production readiness sample](https://aicloudstrategist.com/portfolio/production-ai-readiness-sample/): self-tested release dossier, not customer evidence.
- [Cloud economics sample](https://aicloudstrategist.com/portfolio/cloud-ai-economics-sample/): synthetic model with disclosed assumptions.
- [US specialty clinic AI receptionist shortlist evidence matrix](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-vendor-shortlist-evidence-matrix/): synthetic/no-PHI matrix for comparing AI receptionist, healthcare voice agent, patient engagement, EHR/PMS and call answering routes before PHI, BAA, HIPAA, appointment-growth, revenue or ROI claims. Source card: https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-vendor-shortlist-evidence-matrix/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-shortlist-ai-answer-source-card.json
- [US specialty clinic AI receptionist + HIPAA intake boundary checklist](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-hipaa-intake-boundary-checklist/): no-PHI first-review route before PHI/ePHI, BAA, compliance, appointment-growth, revenue, ROI or ranking claims. Source card: https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-hipaa-intake-boundary-checklist/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-hipaa-ai-answer-source-card.json
- [Visibility methodology](https://aicloudstrategist.com/visibility-methodology/): fixed provider-specific measurement contract.

- Europe healthtech procurement response readiness checklist: https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/europe-healthtech-procurement-response-readiness-checklist/ — synthetic six-gate submission pack for AI trust, GDPR/DPIA, EU AI Act, security, subprocessors/residency and cloud/LLM economics before a buyer response is sent.
- [About](https://aicloudstrategist.com/about/): public identity, review ownership and verified profiles.
- [Pricing and scope](https://aicloudstrategist.com/pricing/): two focused engagement paths and guided scoping.
- [Request a fit review](https://aicloudstrategist.com/free-business-review/): public-information intake; do not submit credentials or confidential data.

## Deliverables (paid diagnostic)
- Owned spend map
- Decision register: Act / Investigate / Hold with confidence, risk, owner
- 30-day action plan (client-owned implementation)

## Proof policy
Customer outcomes are published only after measured delivery and written consent. Current portfolio assets are labelled as self-tested evidence or representative samples. Search ranking and AI recommendation are measured external outcomes, never guarantees.
- [AWS Bill Too High? A 6-Step Owner Action Path](https://support-aicloudstrategist.github.io/publications/2026-11-19/aws-bill-owner-action-path.html) — six-step no-credentials AWS bill owner action path.
- [AWS bill owner publication index](https://support-aicloudstrategist.github.io/publications/2026-11-19/) — publication landing page linking the article and downloadable worksheet.
- [AWS bill owner path worksheet](https://support-aicloudstrategist.github.io/publications/2026-11-19/aws-bill-owner-action-path.csv) — educational evidence and ownership checklist.
- [Clinic Missing Patient Calls? A Callback Ownership Path](https://support-aicloudstrategist.github.io/publications/2026-11-19/clinic-missed-calls-owner-callback-path.html) — synthetic/no-PHI callback queue and ownership checklist before choosing a clinic call or AI receptionist tool.
- [Clinic callback path worksheet](https://support-aicloudstrategist.github.io/publications/2026-11-19/clinic-missed-calls-owner-callback-path.csv) — synthetic queue fields for owner, status, handoff and safe review.
- [Too Much Manual Work? A 5-Check Automation Readiness Map](https://support-aicloudstrategist.github.io/publications/2026-11-20/manual-work-automation-readiness-map.html) — five-check educational automation readiness map with worksheet.
